Hauser 2009 resolves; MED sentence ('data not shown') is body text, not re-seen this pass. bradanicline; NCT01003379 hard gelatin capsules, oral. Drug/route/population right; status unchanged.
Sydserff abstract: quote verbatim. azd-0328; NCT00669903 arms are 'oral solution'. Drug/route/population right; status/year unchanged.

Lieberman abstract (PMID 23303043) quote verbatim; oral 1/5/25 mg. Hauser stated a rat mg/kg MED, no exposure/occupancy/margin: untested/no_prediction per dose table. 8-K EX-99.1 dated 2011-01-19 confirms 2011. Same status as opener dose 1, so no status change.
Hauser abstract: quote verbatim. bradanicline (TC-5619), oral in patients. Drug/route/population right; status unchanged.
Sydserff abstract: quote verbatim. azd-0328, oral solution in NCT00669903. Drug/route/population right; status unchanged.

Registry re-opened: whyStopped verbatim; results first posted 2010-08-06; primary GMLT+OCLT composite day 14; oral solution arms; stable schizophrenia, unselected. azd-0328, oral right; contra 2010 stands.

8-K EX-99.1 re-opened, dated 2011-01-19: 'TC-5619 met the protocol criteria for a positive result on the primary efficacy outcome measure, the GMLT' (one-sided adjusted p=0.054). Lieberman quote verbatim. Year 2011, same, bradanicline, oral, unselected.

Pedersen abstract (epub 2014-07-24) quote verbatim; drugs chosen as 'reported to exert some beneficial effect on negative symptoms'. SANS-primary miss public 2013-12-16/17 first: failed retrodiction, contra, retrodiction true, 2014. Contra rests on pairing with the release.

Release re-opened (BioSpace copy 2013-12-17 of Business Wire): 'TC-5619 did not meet the primary outcome measure ... SANS'. Walling abstract quote verbatim (epub 2015-06-12). Year 2013, contra, bradanicline oral. Judgement prose still says 'Dated 2015' and 'the 2012 same': stale.

missing: Targacept press release 2013-12-16 (Business Wire; copy at https://www.biospace.com/targacept-inc-announces-negative-top-line-results-from-phase-2b-clinical-trial-of-tc-5619-in-schizophrenia-553811): 'TC-5619 did not meet the primary outcome measure, change from baseline on the Scale for the Assessment of Negative Symptoms (SANS) after 24 weeks versus placebo.' Tier-5 record of NCT01488929, 18 months before Walling 2016; it dates efficacy 6 / dose 5 and makes Pedersen 2014 a failed retrodiction.

Targacept 8-K EX-99.1, 2011-01-19 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1124105/000119312511009860/dex991.htm): 'TC-5619 met the protocol criteria for a positive result on the primary efficacy outcome measure, the Groton Maze Learning Task (GMLT) ... and was well tolerated' (one-sided p<0.10, adjusted p=0.054). Tier-5 record of NCT01003379, 23 months before Lieberman 2013; dates efficacy 4 / dose 4 / safety 3.

Mazurov 2012, J Med Chem 10.1021/jm301048a (PMID 23126648, epub 2012-11-13): a tier-1 comparison_stated source that puts the animal models and the phase 2 PoC side by side five weeks before Lieberman; the drafter cites it only in a confidence_note. The 24-word animal-model sentence plus the trial sentence can be quoted in two entries.

ABT-126 healthy-volunteer 'Pharmacokinetic and Exploratory Biomarker Study' NCT00912431 (2009) and PK in stable schizophrenia NCT01043458 (2009): no results posted, no publication found; a possible engagement datum that cannot be verified, so no track can be opened from it.

Checked and not missing: Hayward 2017 low-attentive rat 5C-CPT (10.1016/j.euroneuro.2017.01.013) dosed encenicline only; DBA/2 gating and human P50 data are DMXB-A only; PubMed has no ABT-126 preclinical efficacy paper (abuse liability 2017, MPTP monkey 2015 only); AbbVie posted no registry results for NCT01095562/NCT01655680/NCT01678755. TC-5619 ADHD and ABT-126 Alzheimer's trials are other indications and transfer only to safety via imported_from, which the in-disease safety entries make unnecessary.
rule_questions: Does a tier-5 press release or SEC filing set an entry's `year` when a later tier-1 paper on the same trial sets its status? Rule 6 says 'earliest date the comparison was public' but lists only registry posting, online publication, label and print; rule 2 says tier 5 must be used. Five entries here move 1-2 years earlier if yes.

A retrodiction built against a secondary-endpoint signal (Lieberman 2013 SANS) that a larger primary-endpoint trial had already overturned in public (press release 2013-12-16) before the model paper (2014-07-24): is it `retro` (it reproduced the signal its authors targeted) or `contra` (it failed to reproduce the primary-endpoint result)? Proposed contra.

Dose 'reached' by mg/kg arithmetic alone: when the model stated no exposure or occupancy target and no human PK was published (AZD0328, TC-5619), is bracketing the animal mg/kg range enough for `same` / `contra derived_from efficacy`, or should the dose cell stay `untested`? The v3 dose table has no row for 'unknown whether reached'.
